For roof slopes from 2 1/2 units vertical in 12 units horizontal (21-percent slope), up to four units vertical in 12 units horizontal (33-percent slope), underlayment shall be a minimum of two layers applied as follows:
   1.   Starting at the eave, a 19-inch (482.6 mm) strip of underlayment shall be applied parallel with the eave and fastened sufficiently in place.
   2.   Starting at the eave, 36-inch (914.4 mm) wide strips of underlayment felt shall be applied overlapping successive sheets 19 inches (482.6 mm) and fastened sufficiently in place.
blocks.plainText:
For roof slopes from 2 1/2 units vertical in 12 units horizontal (21-percent slope), up to four units vertical in 12 units horizontal (33-percent slope), underlayment shall be a minimum of two layers applied as follows:

 1. Starting at the eave, a 19-inch (482.6 mm) strip of underlayment shall be applied parallel with the eave and fastened sufficiently in place.

 2. Starting at the eave, 36-inch (914.4 mm) wide strips of underlayment felt shall be applied overlapping successive sheets 19 inches (482.6 mm) and fastened sufficiently in place.
